title: CUB beat custom scan on untrained affine fixtures
question: Did custom hierarchical scan lower the cost of the same bounded affine-summary computation?

source.measurement_revision: Final combined-source replay; source hashes are recorded in results/selection/source_hashes.json.
source.basis: Verified historical record: report and tracked raw receipts were read locally; all six final integrated source hashes match the files in this checkout. No measurement was rerun for documentation.

metric.uncertainty: P95 values are retained in each raw receipt; no confidence interval or independent repeat is available

environment.precision: float, Release without fast math (as recorded)

claim: In these untrained synthetic affine-summary fixtures, CUB had a lower recorded median than the custom scan at both tested sizes. The defined ordered summary composed exactly across two levels with source intervals, but this does not establish sequence utility or a learned genomic hierarchy.
limitations: Synthetic four-float records with untrained fixture parameters; no biological sequence labels or genome-derived inputs.
Device-resident pipeline only: excludes allocation, host fixture construction, H2D/D2H, and result interpretation.
The two sample sizes and variants are one recorded invocation each (31 timed samples); p95 is not a confidence interval.
The final combined-source replay is distinct from earlier per-case receipts. This result uses only the final combined-source receipts and does not pool them.
This is an exactness/cost observation for a restricted affine operator, not evidence of general context construction or information preservation.

Tracked raw receipts contain the original machine-local binary path in their command field; their recorded stdout is path-independent, and the reproduction recipe below uses relative repository commands.
reproduce:
Historical recipe only; no rerun was made for this documentation pass. With CUDA 12.9, sm_70, and the canonical controller holding the assigned GPU resource, use:

```sh
python3 experiments/cuda_lab/tools/run.py \
  --phase build-cuda \
  --build-dir build-bitop-BP-CUDA-LAB-final-cuda
python3 experiments/cuda_lab/results/\
selection/replay.py parent
python3 experiments/cuda_lab/tools/\
check.py --all-results
```

The replay runs the recorded all-case sanitizer and benchmark checks. Do not invoke its GPU work without the actual exclusive resource lease.

selection.rationale: One narrow historical control result: preserves ordered-composition correctness while making the unfavorable executor comparison explicit. Selected for explanatory value, not because it is a speedup. Rethread is omitted as a separate public page; its full sweep remains in the linked selection report and combined raw receipts.
